name: El Pla de Santa Maria (Spain)
description: Dark blue field charged with a white embattled wall with two open towers surmounted by yellow crosses, above a lighter blue base.
history: The flag of El Pla de Santa Maria is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark blue, with the wall with white open towers and the yellow crosses of the arms arranged in fess, the base of the wall at 3/12 from the lower edge; approved on 7 May 1999. The turreted wall with the two crosses is a traditional sign of the arms of the town.

features.role: embattled wall with two open towers
